chunks: Safwan narrated from Al-ʿĪṣ ibn Al-Qāsim, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the pilgrims from Kūfah: is it better that they begin with Madinah or with Makkah? He said: "With Madinah."

key_terms.الْكُوفَةِ: Kufah, the city from which the pilgrims are traveling
key_terms.بِالْمَدِينَةِ: beginning with Madinah; the preferred starting point mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.بِمَكَّةَ: beginning with Makkah, presented as the alternative option

ai.seo_question: For pilgrims coming from Kufa, is it better to begin with Medina or Mecca?
ai.summary: This hadith records a ruling on the preferred starting point for pilgrims traveling from Kūfah. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that beginning with Madinah is better.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3141 - Safwan narrated from Al-'Iys ibn Al-Qasim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the pilgrims from Kufa—whether starting with Medina or Mecca is better.
Imam (as) replied: "With Medina."
